guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Weekly Radar public types and port have Rust documentation comments.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep Weekly Radar Domain and Application independent of external systems and other feature implementations.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The new context uses standard-library types and provider-agnostic ports only.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: A publication must remain bound to one immutable snapshot identity; delivery must not trigger recalculation.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: WeeklyRadarPublication stores one WeeklyRadarSnapshot and exposes its identity without calculation logic.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep persistence, rendering, Telegram, Scheduler, retry, and receipt behavior outside this Contract.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Only boundary modules and a publisher port are added; external adapter behavior remains deferred.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not add dependencies for this Contract.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Cargo.toml is unchanged and implementation uses the standard library.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Contract, design spec, and plan record the policy for in-scope corrections.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not introduce trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Weekly Radar boundary contains research publication facts only.

risk.detail: The boundary is stable, but later WIs must preserve the snapshot identity when adding typed read models and delivery behavior.

residualRisks.detail: WR-002 and later WIs must extend the snapshot boundary without allowing rendering or delivery to recalculate facts.
Future publisher receipt/retry behavior must remain outside this initial port contract or be amended explicitly in its own WI.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
expectedReviewFocus: Publication cannot mix facts from different snapshots
Publisher port has no Telegram or external runtime coupling

userCorrectionsCaptured.correction: If an issue is discovered during the corresponding work, resolve it within the current WI whenever it remains in scope; do not casually open a new WI to prevent scope diffusion.

userCorrectionSolidification.correction: Keep in-scope fixes in the current Work Item and avoid WI proliferation.
userCorrectionSolidification.evidence: Contract, design spec, and plan include the current-WI issue policy; future typed calculations remain explicitly out of scope.

checkpointEvidence.reason: 将三个已执行场景的验证状态与证据写回当前 Contract，完成 WR-001 的生命周期证据闭环，不扩展业务边界。
为当前 WI 纳入 reference-impact 证据文件及其所有权，以通过新增 interface 层的兼容性证据检查；不扩展业务边界。
将用户对 24 个 WI 的明确授权绑定到当前 WI 的受限 reference-impact 证据写入，满足 AI Cockpit 的治理路径所有权要求。

knownGaps: WR-002 owns persistence and historical immutability; this WI only defines the in-memory snapshot envelope.
WR-003 through WR-014 own typed calculations, renderers, delivery, retry, scheduling, and system health integration.
overclaimPrevention: Do not report completion for checks or behavior that were not verified.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Snapshot metadata is retained and publication identity is bound to the snapshot.
scenarioCoverage.expected: All six metadata values are returned unchanged, and a publication exposes the same snapshot identity it was created with.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Publication facts remain ordered and duplicate fact identities are rejected.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Facts are returned in insertion order and a repeated fact identity returns a deterministic domain error.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Publisher port is isolated from Telegram and external runtime details.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The port accepts WeeklyRadarPublication without external imports and architecture/module-boundary checks pass.
